confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of unauthorized access and data exfiltration. The user logged in from an unusual IP address (not in baseline) and performed a high volume of file reads followed by multiple large file downloads across two consecutive days, which significantly exceeds the user's baseline of 1 download per day.

attack_chain.description: Unauthorized access via login from an unusual IP address (45.79.97.21) instead of the baseline IP (192.168.1.108).
Initial reconnaissance/data collection through reading multiple legal files.
First instance of data exfiltration via file download (review_662.json).
Second instance of data exfiltration via file download (draft_654.json).
Continued unauthorized access on a second day from the same unusual IP, starting during off-hours.
Escalated data exfiltration pattern on day two, involving multiple large file downloads (audit_107.pptx, policy_765.pdf, forecast_131.yaml, etc.).

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 45.79.97.21 belongs to a known VPN or legitimate remote access service used by the company.
Information regarding whether user_08 was on approved leave or traveling, which might explain the IP change and off-hours access.
narrative: User_08, a corporate counsel, accessed the environment from an unrecognized IP address and engaged in a pattern of reading and downloading a high volume of legal documents. This behavior, spanning two days and involving multiple large file downloads, significantly deviates from the user's established baseline and indicates a successful data exfiltration incident.
